_comment: LLM token prices. Edit this file, not code. Rates are USD per 1,000,000 tokens, Gemini API paid tier, Standard. 'output' includes thinking tokens, as the provider bills them. Context-cache storage (per token-hour) is not listed: this app creates no explicit caches, so only the cached-input read rate applies. A model missing here is reported as unpriced, never estimated.
